title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: Help without handing over
hook: A parent offers to help. What job do you give them?
intro: You need another adult at practice.
You also want the team to hear one voice.
statement: Clear jobs make parent help easier for everyone.
q1: Do you give helpers a specific station to run —
q2: or let them help wherever they see a need?
t1: Both can work. But help goes further
t2: when every adult knows their part.
cta: Coaches — how do you use parent helpers?
ctaLines: Run a station. Shag balls. Feed the pitching machine.
ctaPrompt: Share your helper habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent offers to help. What job do you give them?
You need another adult at practice. You also want the team to hear one voice.
Clear jobs make parent help easier for everyone.
A set job or open help. Both can work.
How do you use parent helpers? Share your habit in the comments.
